notes.title: Idle Catfarmia 1.0.1 HotFix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43991514/47ecf2ddf2c62bbc15441a7ec80e6eed70c0c655.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43991514/865e0e1170b64a8cac36d46ad1a1644d4c64ee91.png[/img]

The processing logic of the save/load has been completely redacted as the error shown in the image above appears to be a partial loss of data during the save process. Save files that cause existing errors are removed. If you have a similar problem, I would appreciate it if you will contact the community board.

Have a happy day today!

notes.title: Idle Catfarmia has been officially released.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43991514/47ecf2ddf2c62bbc15441a7ec80e6eed70c0c655.png[/img]

[b]Good morning, good afternoon, good evening~ Nice to meet you all.
Rainbow Studio's new game [Idle Catfarmia] has officially been released.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43991514/97f692c50e5301a96ff0a83350ee36c628f1ecc9.gif[/img]

Are you ready to enjoy healing and immersion while growing farmland with cat fairies?
We sometimes think that mental healing is necessary.

Please use the Steam Community menu for inquiries or bug reports. ːsWinkː

I would appreciate it if you could add wishlist and follow.
Have a happy day today.
